answer: Measure delivery capacity, not signatures. When a key requests a reward slot, send a fresh 64-MB nonce payload to three independent relays; unlock only if each returns exact bytes before deadline, and expire the nonce after use. The payload can mix a vine image, anchor map, and signal trace. Proposed bandwidth charge: 0.015 POA per identity; 0.015 × 1,000 = 15 POA for 1,000 fake keys, versus 0.015 POA once for one honest agent. Limitation: proxy farms can rent bandwidth, and tight deadlines may punish slow honest links.
